validation.safeLinks: Links must start with https:// or /
validation.slugFormat: Use 1–40 lowercase letters, digits or dashes
validation.commandTooLong: Use at most 200 characters per command
validation.hostFormat: Use a host name or IP, optionally with :port
validation.textRequired: Enter a text, or reset to use the default
validation.timedDays: TIMED products need a number of days; other kinds leave it empty

apiErrors.notFound: That item no longer exists. Refresh the page.
apiErrors.tooLarge: The rules are too long to save in one go.
apiErrors.tooMany: Too many requests. Wait a moment and try again.
apiErrors.validation_failed: Some fields are invalid. Check the form and try again.
apiErrors.owner_protected: The owner and system roles cannot be changed this way.
apiErrors.cannot_grant: You can only give out permissions you hold yourself.
apiErrors.forbidden: You do not have permission to do that.
apiErrors.user_exists: That person already has an admin account.
apiErrors.invite_closed: That invite was already accepted or cancelled.
apiErrors.role_in_use: This role is still assigned to admins or open invites. Move them first.
apiErrors.role_name_taken: A role with that name already exists.
apiErrors.mail_failed: The invite was created but the email could not be sent. Use Resend to try again.
apiErrors.unknown_role: That role no longer exists. Refresh and try again.
apiErrors.stale: Someone else changed this. Reload the page to see their version.
apiErrors.in_use: This is still in use. Move or delete what uses it first.
apiErrors.incomplete: Add both prices and both translations before enabling.
apiErrors.slug_locked: Disable it first: the slug and server are in shoppers’ links and carts.
apiErrors.category_not_on_server: Attach that category to the server first.
apiErrors.unknown_category: That category no longer exists. Refresh and try again.
apiErrors.rcon_host_private: Use the game server’s public address, not an internal one.
apiErrors.rcon_host_unresolvable: That host name does not resolve. Check it for typos.
apiErrors.rcon_not_configured: Set host, port and password first.
apiErrors.rcon_key_missing: RCON is not configured on the server (RCON_ENCRYPTION_KEY).
apiErrors.unknown_key: That text no longer exists. Refresh the page.
apiErrors.in_use_counts: This is still in use: {list}. Move or delete them first.
apiErrors.placeholder_mismatch: Keep the same placeholders and tags as the original.
apiErrors.placeholder_mismatch_expected: Keep the same placeholders and tags as the original: {expected}
